description: Issue #145, exclusion 1 of 4 (ADR section 7): 「unit test は不要」/ "no new unit test is needed". Both criteria carry a test noun AND an active verb — 追加 / "added" — so the positive rule alone WOULD fire, which is what makes this exclusion load-bearing rather than decorative: delete it and this case goes red. The author already decided; a planner that stops the run to ask anyway is overruling a stated decision, and that is the fastest way for this warning to lose its reader — after which `--allow-questions` becomes habit and silences the real `no_acceptance_criteria` alongside it. The declared file is a shell script both times, so nothing is derived and the silence is the exclusion's alone.
